title: Rank repair targets by slack-weighted count of violating endpoints sharing each driver (multi-endpoint path-sharing) instead of per-path load delay
hypothesis: Stock SetupLegacyBase::rankPathDrivers orders drivers on a single endpoint's worst path by local load-dependent delay, so a driver on hundreds of violating paths (Ibex _26153_/ZN, fanout 943) gets no priority over a driver on one path. Build a deterministic, capped (top 400 violators, refreshed every 25 endpoints) shared-criticality map summing normalised negative slack of every violating endpoint whose worst path passes through each driver, and rank targets by load_delay*(1+share). Acceptance, generators and repair budget stay stock, avoiding iteration 8's admission/trial machinery that collapsed AES's move mix and timed out JPEG. Each move on a high-share driver improves many endpoints at once, so TNS should drop sharply on Ibex/JPEG while AES (diffuse sharing) stays near stock. RSZ_EVOLVE counters will report builds, rank changes and build time.

evaluator.lesson: Shared-criticality ranking reduced Ibex TNS magnitude by 52.28% but changed repair trajectories enough to worsen AES and JPEG, so sharing needs bounded influence and evidence of structural concentration.
evaluator.dead_end: Applying load_delay*(1+share) broadly while keeping acceptance and generators stock does not preserve the move mix or protect QoR.
good_changes: src/rsz/src/policy/SetupLegacyBase.cc: shared-criticality target ranking coincided with Ibex TNS improving by 34.327145 ns and increased resizing and cloning
src/rsz/src/policy/SetupLegacyBase.cc: changed-first counters establish that the new ranking executed and materially affected target selection
bad_changes: src/rsz/src/policy/SetupLegacyBase.cc: uncapped-influence share multiplication changed JPEG's first target on 92.8% of ranking passes while resizes fell from 282 to 54
src/rsz/src/policy/SetupLegacyBase.cc: broad shared ranking failed the AES near-stock prediction, with TNS magnitude increasing 59.17%
src/rsz/src/policy/SetupLegacyBase.hh: the 400-path cap and 25-call refresh bound path expansion but do not ensure repairability, freshness, or measured build cost
